SILAC-Based Proteomic Source Attribution and EV-PC Protein Classification

Xueli Xu

2026-10-23

1 Overview

This notebook reproduces the full Heavy/Light isotope-based serum-source analysis using the serumsource R package. The analysis asks, for every protein quantified by SILAC-style dual-channel EV proteomics: is this protein really carried by serum, or is it just background / residual EV material?

The core logic:

  1. For each protein and replicate we compute the Light fraction \(L/(L+H)\). Serum proteins are enriched in the Light channel.
  2. The control group UCEV defines the background noise floor (robust SD of the Light fraction).
  3. A target EV group is called serum-derived only when its Light fraction clearly exceeds that noise floor with enough replicate support.
  4. Source correction (p0) converts the excess into an estimated serum fraction and calibrated serum Light intensity.

Downstream visualisation, CSV/XLSX export and the Markdown report are provided by the separate downstream_analysis.R script that ships alongside the package.

2 Configuration

library(serumsource)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dplyr))
library(knitr)

# Input data
input_file  <- "F:/WYF/NP_1/MaxQuant_annotated_with_total.xlsx"
sheet_name  <- 1

# Output directory
output_dir <- "F:/WYF/NP_1/提交/full_analysis_report/output"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Sample metadata (group -> column mapping)
sample_info <- build_sample_info()

# Control and target groups
reference_group <- "UCEV"
target_groups   <- NULL   # NULL = all groups except reference_group

# Thresholds (defaults; see ?serum_source_params)
params <- serum_source_params()

2.1 Threshold parameters

params_df <- data.frame(
  Parameter = names(params),
  Value     = as.character(unlist(params)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
kable(params_df, caption = "Statistical and filter criteria (serum_source_params)")
Statistical and filter criteria (serum_source_params)
Parameter Value
min_valid_reps 2
min_absolute_light_excess 0.05
background_multiplier_high 3
background_multiplier_medium 2
min_support_reps_when_three_valid 2
min_support_reps_when_two_valid 2
max_serum_fraction_cv_high_confidence 0.5
minimum_fraction_sd_floor 0.02
min_light_dominance_ratio 0.7
eps 1e-12

Target groups (inferred automatically from sample_info excluding the reference group):

all_groups    <- unique(sample_info$group)
target_groups <- setdiff(all_groups, reference_group)
cat("Reference group:", reference_group, "\n")
## Reference group: UCEV
cat("Target groups:  ", paste(target_groups, collapse = ", "), "\n")
## Target groups:   DGEV_PC_1-3, DGEV_PC_10-12, DGEV_PC_4-9, UCEVPC

4 Read Input Data

raw <- read_input_data(input_file, sheet_name = sheet_name)
cat("Rows (proteins):", nrow(raw), "\n")
## Rows (proteins): 5298
cat("Columns:        ", ncol(raw), "\n")
## Columns:         116

5 Prepare Long-format Data

prepare_long_data() converts intensities to numeric, builds unique protein row IDs, constructs the per-replicate long table with replicate-validity and Light-dominance flags, computes the Light fraction, and attaches protein annotation.

prep <- prepare_long_data(raw, sample_info)
lh_long <- prep$lh_long

cat("Long-format rows:", nrow(lh_long), "\n")
## Long-format rows: 79470
cat("Groups:           ", paste(unique(lh_long$group), collapse = ", "), "\n")
## Groups:            UCEV, DGEV_PC_1-3, DGEV_PC_10-12, DGEV_PC_4-9, UCEVPC
cat("Annotation columns attached:\n")
## Annotation columns attached:
cat(paste(" -", intersect(c("Protein_Row_ID", "Gene_names",
                            "Database_evidence"), names(lh_long)),
          collapse = "\n"), "\n")
##  - Protein_Row_ID
##  - Gene_names
##  - Database_evidence

6 UCEV Background Variation

compute_ucev_background() estimates the per-protein robust SD of the Light fraction in the control group and derives a global SD floor (max(minimum_fraction_sd_floor, median)).

bg <- compute_ucev_background(lh_long, reference_group = reference_group)
cat("Proteins with valid UCEV reps:", nrow(bg$sd_table), "\n")
## Proteins with valid UCEV reps: 804
cat("Global SD floor:               ", round(bg$global_fraction_sd_floor, 4), "\n")
## Global SD floor:                0.02
source("F:/WYF/NP_1/提交/SerumSourceAnalyzer/downstream/downstream_analysis.R")
plot_ucev_background(bg$sd_table, bg$global_fraction_sd_floor)

Distribution of UCEV Light-fraction SD with the global floor

7 Run Core Analysis

run_core_analysis() runs the full computation in one call: reading, long table, UCEV background, per-group classification and source correction. It performs no I/O.

core <- run_core_analysis(
  input_file      = input_file,
  sheet_name      = sheet_name,
  sample_info     = sample_info,
  reference_group = reference_group,
  target_groups   = target_groups,
  params          = params
)

Elements returned by run_core_analysis():

data.frame(Element = names(core)) %>%
  kable(caption = "List elements returned by run_core_analysis()")
List elements returned by run_core_analysis()
Element
lh_long
annotation
data_converted
ucev_sd
global_fraction_sd_floor
results
all_merged
primary_serum
case_summary
database_summary

12 Calibrated Serum Light Intensity

all_merged adds Serum_L_Calibrated_<sample> columns back onto the original protein table, converting each replicate’s excess into calibrated serum Light intensity units.

cal_cols <- grep("^Serum_L_Calibrated", names(core$all_merged), value = TRUE)
cat("Calibrated columns added:", length(cal_cols), "\n")
## Calibrated columns added: 12
core$all_merged %>%
  select(Protein_Row_ID, Gene_names, all_of(cal_cols[1:min(4, length(cal_cols))])) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  kable(caption = "Preview of calibrated serum Light intensity (first 4 samples)")

13 Save Outputs

Write CSV tables, an XLSX workbook and a Markdown report to output_dir.

run_downstream_analysis(
  core_result     = core,
  input_file      = input_file,
